value.rationale: The 2026 derivative-basis construction motivates a genuine completeness decision: a rank plateau can precede further new directions even on an everywhere SPD diagonal family. The exact 2n-2 universal derivative-order cutoff and sharp rank staircase are structural, problem-sized and not a mere isolated finite table. They give a rigorous boundary on any exact-arithmetic stopping rule and clarify the limitation of companion-state dimension reasoning; not a performance-rate or PDE theorem.
